studies.title: Edaravone Dexborneol for Post-Stroke Epilepsy
interventions: Treatment of edaravone dexborneol sublingual tablets containin edaravone 30 mg plus borneol 6 mg, twice daily (with an interval of ≥6 hours between doses) for three months.
studies.sponsor: First Affiliated Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University
studies.summary:
This is a prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter clinical trial designed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Edaravone Dexborneol sublingual tablets in preventing late-onset epilepsy in patients with acute ischemic stroke at high risk.

Eligible participants are adults aged 18-80 years with a confirmed diagnosis of acute ischemic stroke by clinical and imaging criteria (MRI or CT), enrolled within 48 hours of stroke onset. studies.title: Nasal Irrigation With Chinese Herbal Medicine as an Adjunctive Treatment in Allergic Rhinitis
interventions: Szechwan Lovage Rhizome, Biod Magnolia Bud, Taiwan Angelica Root, Wild Mint Herb, Baikal Skullcap Root, and Borneol
studies.summary: In allergic rhinitis patients with severe symptoms, control of severe allergic reactions is limited with saline nasal irrigation. Therefore, there have been several attempts to use saline nasal irrigation in combination with other treatments to treat allergic rhinitis. This study tries to explore the effect of nasal irrigation with Chinese herbal medicines on allergic rhinitis.

studies.summary: Hypothesis: acupoint application is effective for managing chronic stable angina pectoris. Aim: to evaluate the efficacy and safety of acupoint application on the specific acupoints for chronic stable angina pectoris. Design: A Randomized, Controlled,Double Blind trial. 200 participants will be included. Four arms: herbal medicine application on acupoint group , placebo application on acupoint group , herbal medicine application on non-acupoint group and placebo application on non-acupoint group.

studies.title: Safety, Tolerability and Pharmacokinetics of Y-2(Edaravone And Borneol) Sublingual Tablet
studies.summary: The primary objective is to evaluate the safety and tolerability of single ascending dose of Y-2 sublingual tablets in healthy male and female adult subjects. The secondary objective is to characterize the single-dose pharmacokinetics of Y-2 sublingual tablets in healthy male and female adult subjects.

consumer_summary.what_it_is: Borneol is a bicyclic monoterpenoid, a fragrant molecule with a sharp, camphor-like scent. As a volatile oil component, it is something you encounter frequently in the aromas of everyday culinary herbs and traditional botanical preparations.
consumer_summary.found_in: It is a key aromatic compound in familiar plants like rosemary (Rosmarinus officinalis), sage (Salvia officinalis), and thyme (Thymus vulgaris), as well as ginger and valerian root.
consumer_summary.why_researchers_care: Researchers are drawn to borneol for its remarkable ability to interact with the blood-brain barrier, exploring its potential as both a neuroprotective agent and a vehicle for targeted drug delivery. Much of the excitement centers on its use in neurological care, supported by systematic reviews of randomised trials (Oxford level 1a). Scientists are also investigating its role in advanced biomaterials, such as all-natural antibacterial hydrogels.

hypothesized_benefits.hypothesis: Researchers are exploring whether borneol, particularly when combined with other agents like edaravone, can protect brain tissue during and after ischemic events.
hypothesized_benefits.study_to_test_it: A Phase 3 trial (NCT07604350, not yet recruiting) is set to evaluate Edaravone Dexborneol for post-stroke epilepsy in 160 patients.

eco.label: author statement supported by traceable reference

hypothesized_benefits.hypothesis: Early observational and lab work points toward borneol having a role in cellular apoptosis, raising questions about how it might interact with abnormal cells.
hypothesized_benefits.study_to_test_it: A randomized, placebo-controlled human trial measuring specific tumor biomarkers and progression over 12 months would elevate this from observational (Oxford 2b) evidence.

hypothesized_benefits.hypothesis: Because it is found in calming herbs like valerian, researchers are exploring whether borneol directly contributes to relaxation and anxiety relief.
hypothesized_benefits.study_to_test_it: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled human trial measuring validated anxiety scores over 4 weeks would move this beyond current animal (Oxford 5) models.

hypothesized_benefits.hypothesis: Scientists are investigating whether borneol can be integrated into novel materials, like injectable hydrogels, to provide localized antibacterial defense.
hypothesized_benefits.study_to_test_it: A randomized clinical trial testing a borneol-infused topical hydrogel against a standard antibacterial ointment for superficial skin infections over 14 days.

consumer_summary.evidence_at_a_glance: Best evidence so far is human clinical trials and systematic reviews (Oxford 1a) for neuroprotection and inflammation, while research into its antimicrobial and cellular effects remains largely observational and preclinical.
